checked_scope: The integer-margin replication reduction and deletion bounds for least-unpopularity margin.
checks: Private unmatched dummies turn fixed-incumbent vote maximization into weighted assignment with integer optimum margin in [0,n]. Disjoint challenger choices and incumbent optimizations add exactly across components.

For t copies and g(tN)<t, total margin<t(mu_star+1) forces an integer-optimal component; evaluating components identifies it. For C N^(1-epsilon), polynomial t suffices for fixed C,epsilon; arbitrary g=o(N), such as N/log N, does not imply polynomial replication.

Restricting matchings/challengers to a core and leaving deleted applicants unmatched in the reverse direction changes vote sums by at most k. Thus |mu_star(I)-mu_star(core)|<=k and any extension of a popular core preserving core assignments has margin<=k. External NP-hardness is outside verification.
